Welcome to the GeoLookup community. This is a place to ask questions, explore ideas and share how you use the package.

Start with the [community guide](https://github.com/moztopia/moztopia-geolookup/wiki/Community) and [package documentation](https://github.com/moztopia/moztopia-geolookup/wiki). Use Issues for reproducible bugs, and keep an existing issue or PR's implementation conversation in that thread.

Please use synthetic examples and remove credentials and personal location data before posting.
